sports.note: Hand corrections for tools/trace-ground.mjs --layer sports. extraSites: grounds not (fully) in OSM; sites.<id>: skip, margin, hints, drop (fit names), surfaces / lines (world frame) added as they are.

markings.note: tools/trace-ground.mjs --layer markings: auto traces every `cell` m square of the town with minBuildings buildings and a street; areas adds boxes of its own.

classes.note: Areas whose open ground tools/trace-ground.mjs --layer classes classifies into data/ground-classes/ (every hires orthophoto tile touching them); auto: also every tile with minBuildings buildings.
